# Energy flow (`energy-flow`)

Solar, grid, battery and home as nodes with animated flows sized by power, and import or export direction.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createEnergyFlow` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/energyFlow.d.ts`): `.mh-energy-flow`: solar, grid, battery and home as circles with the power moving between them as dots along the links, wider and faster with more power, each with a chevron for its direction. Under reduced motion the dots become still lines; the chevrons stay. Scales with its container down to a watch face (`compact` drops the words).

```ts
export function createEnergyFlow(options: EnergyFlowOptions): EnergyFlowHandle;

export interface EnergyFlowOptions extends EnergyFlowReadings {
  /** The accessible name (default "Energy flow"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Battery charge in percent, shown under the battery. */
  batteryLevel?: number | null;
  /** Power per edge, when the system reports it; default worked out from the readings. */
  flows?: Partial<EnergyFlows>;
  /** The power drawn at full width and speed, in watts (default the largest flow, at least 1 kW). */
  scale?: number;
  /** Flows below this are drawn as idle, in watts (default 10). */
  threshold?: number;
  /** Icons and values only, for watches and small tiles. */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Formats watts (default "850 W", "1.2 kW"). */
  format?: (watts: number) => string;
  labels?: Partial<EnergyFlowLabels>;
}

export interface EnergyFlowHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces everything shown; running animations carry on. */
  update(options: EnergyFlowOptions): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface EnergyFlowLabels {
  solar: string;
  grid: string;
  battery: string;
  home: string;
  producing: string;
  importing: string;
  exporting: string;
  charging: string;
  discharging: string;
  using: string;
  idle: string;
  unknown: string;
  /** Joins two places in the spoken flow list ("Solar to home"). */
  to: string;
  /** Short visible words under a value. */
  import: string;
  export: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createEnergyFlow } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Watts. Grid is negative while exporting, battery negative while charging.
const flow = createEnergyFlow({
  label: 'Energy now',
  solar: 3200,
  grid: -1100,
  battery: -800,
  home: 1300,
  batteryLevel: 64,
});

// Evening: the sun is down and the battery feeds the home.
setTimeout(() => {
  flow.update({ label: 'Energy now', solar: 0, grid: 300, battery: 900, batteryLevel: 52 });
}, 3000);

document.body.append(flow.el);
```
